schema:name: Hand Harvesting Coffee Cherries, Sumatra, Indonesia
schema:description:
This image shows a worker harvesting ripe coffee cherries by hand in Sumatra. He has a collecting pail hanging around his neck and is wearing a woven sun hat.

Hacienda La Minita serves as Distant Lands Coffee’s green coffee trading division, sourcing specialty coffee from countries such as Ethiopia. Coffee in Ethiopia is grown largely by smallholder farmers and processed at local cooperatives and washing stations.
